description: This is a test class file for the PartialTheme data transfer object (DTO) within the OrangeHRM corporate branding plugin. It contains a setup method to populate test data and a test method to verify creation of a PartialTheme from a Theme entity.

classes.name: PartialThemeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the PartialTheme DTO creation from Theme entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testCreateFromTheme
methods.description: Tests the creation of a PartialTheme DTO from a Theme entity and verifies its properties.
